selected_pattern: GitHub Pages static presentation plus complete offline-equivalent bundle; optional bounded Cloud Run progressive enhancement

alternatives.name: Static GitHub Pages Demo
strengths: no backend credentials or mutation surface
limitations: deterministic trust checks are replayed unless an optional local/browser verifier is accepted

alternatives.name: Static Frontend plus Cloud Backend
strengths: bounded live read-only retrieval and deterministic verification
frontend remains useful during total backend outage
limitations: CORS, rate limiting, quota, timeout, cold-start and cost controls
GPU/model operational proof remains a separate task

alternatives.name: Full Hosted Demo Application
limitations: couples frontend, backend, model and graph failure
does not strengthen frozen research evidence
